title: Loan API restart loop after 1.2.0 pilot release (502 errors every ~8 minutes)
system: Tredgate Loan container pilot (gateway, loan-api, docs-search)
timezone: Europe/Prague (CEST, UTC+02:00); container logs are in UTC

impact.symptom: Gateway returns 502 for about 30 seconds after each loan-api restart; installment preview, list and decisions fail during that window
impact.data_loss: none (Total Applications tile 12 after rollback, equals shift log plus 3 paper applications)
impact.personal_data: applicant names written to the loan-api log by 1.2.0 (installment cache miss lines); count of distinct applicants to be taken from the log
impact.numbers_from_logs: restart count, failed/total requests and distinct applicant names are to be derived from logs/combined.log by the postmortem author

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: Acknowledged. Uptime 241 s at 09:17 implies a restart at 09:13. Exporting docker compose logs and docker events.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: Gateway error log shows 'upstream timed out' for POST /docs/reindex (docs-search). Developer suspects VLAN change.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: Data file parses, GET /api/loans returns 9 records, no level 50 lines. Data-file hypothesis dropped.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: Upstream timeouts also present before the release (08:05, 08:50): handbook reindex cron vs 5 s gateway timeout. Not related.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: docker events: container oom, die exitCode=137 for loan-api (mem_limit 256m). Started lines at 09:13, 09:22, 09:30, 09:38, 09:46: 5 restarts so far, about every 8 minutes. Watchdog cron restarts the container.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineer on-call
work_notes.note: process metrics: heapUsedMB and cacheEntries grow linearly after each start (about 65 MB / 1300 entries before the kill). Cause: 1.2.0 installment cache without eviction. 'installment cache miss' lines contain applicantName.

work_notes.author: Release Engineer
work_notes.note: loan-api recreated from the 1.1.0 image. Health ok, no version field.

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: Update #1 sent on the branch channel.

work_notes.author: Operations Lead
work_notes.note: Resolved after 68 minutes of monitoring without errors. Resolved message sent.

work_notes.author: Platform Engineering Lead
work_notes.note: Postmortem requested by 2026-10-12 (OPS-040). Known Issue entry KI-005 to be filed.

related.known_issue: KI-005 (to be filed with the postmortem)
